result.title: Stagewise Adaptive Boosting
result.summary: Stagewise algorithms and sparsity-inducing regularization are two influential approaches to high-dimensional modeling. Existing stagewise theory, however, largely centers on convex regularization, whereas stronger sparsity and other structural preferences are often pursued through fixed-level nonconvex optimization rather than generating an entire adaptive solution path. We develop stagewise adaptive boosting, a general framework that builds a monotone path by selecting the update consistent with structural preference. The framework can encourage sparsity along the path itself and also admits extensions that promote other properties of the solution, including group selection, similarity across models for multiple outcomes, and known priorities or prerequisite relations among predictors. We study its theoretical property as well as finite sample performance using simulations and real-data analyses. Across these studies, the proposed pathwise approach often achieves predictive performance comparable to commonly used baselines while selecting substantially smaller models. These results suggest that adaptive stagewise learning provides a practical route to stronger sparsity and richer structural control without repeatedly solving separate weighted or nonconvex optimization problems.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 stagewise adaptive boosting 框架：每步按结构偏好从候选更新中挑选一个，构造单调解路径，以在路径上实现稀疏、分组选择、多输出模型相似性及预测变量先验顺序等约束，并用理论与模拟、真实数据分析评估。
AI.relevance_reason: 距离视觉推理较远，但其「逐步选择与结构偏好一致的更新、路径长度即稀疏程度」的思路，可能为 latent 推理中的状态更新筛选与少步即足够（STOP）偏好提供类比线索，可供核查。
